_doc: Which source fills each output field. Any field not listed here is generated by the model ('llm').
portal = copied as-is from the iGOT portal (Learning API, or local export + course_metadata_v3).
code   = computed or overwritten in Python after the model call; removed from the model's schema.
Paths are dotted, e.g. 'explain.sto_reason'. Edit this file to change what Gemini is asked for;
tools/field_config_from_excel.py can regenerate it from the 'Fields' sheet of the review workbook.
Defaults (Nov 2026): portal = title/description/duration (confirmed correct on the platform);
code = fields the pipeline already computes; off = clear duplicates only. The remaining judgement
calls (LearningTone, KeywordsExtracted, SuggestedLearningPath, LearningMode, ...) stay 'llm' until
stakeholders confirm the final field list.
